name: Reaper Behemoth grants Stamina and Armor Penetration Rating (#2172)
contract: Behemoth 573041 reads 'Increases your Stamina by 20% and your Armor penetration by 10% of your Strength.'

Spell.dbc gives it two effects: effect 0 is aura 137 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE) MiscValue 2 (Stamina); effect 1 is aura 220 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_RATING_FROM_STAT) MiscValue 16777216 (bit 24 = CR_ARMOR_PENETRATION).
Both auras are native and generic (AuraEffect::HandleModTotalPercentStat, AuraEffect::HandleModRatingFromStat -> Player::ApplyRatingMod); no CoA-specific code is required.
The same generic aura 220 already delivers the identical 'percent of a stat converted to a rating' tooltip clause for the closed #651 Forbidden Power passive.
A Reaper who learns 573041 must show a higher Stamina total and a nonzero Armor Penetration Rating than an untalented control.

steps.label: Fixture precondition: no Armor Penetration Rating yet
Talented Armor Penetration Rating becomes nonzero
Control Armor Penetration Rating stays zero
